newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Hyundai invests in Elprom-Trapho Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai invests in Elprom-Trapho Bulgaria.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Corp on Tuesday signed an agreement to buy 70 percent of Bulgaria's Elprom-Trapho power transformer maker for $2.9 million, the Privatisation Agency said.
It said Hyundai had pledged to invest $4 million over the next five years in modernising the Sofia-based company, whose 1995 turnover was about $8.2 million.
Of the remaining shares, 20 percent will be offered to employees and 10 percent will be sold under Bulgaria's mass privatisation programme.
Under the agreement, Hyundai must preserve Elprom's existing 1,020 jobs for at least three years, but may then reduce them to 750 within two years.
South Korean giants Daewoo and Samsung are also active in Bulgarian privatisations. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
